benefits.name: 4X on Dining
benefits.description: Earn 4 points per $1 at restaurants worldwide on up to $50,000 per calendar year (then 1X).

benefits.name: 4X on U.S. Supermarkets
benefits.description: Earn 4 points per $1 at U.S. supermarkets on up to $25,000 per calendar year (then 1X).

benefits.name: 3X on Flights
benefits.description: Earn 3 points per $1 on flights booked directly with airlines or on AmexTravel.com.

benefits.name: 1X Base Rate
benefits.description: Earn 1 point per $1 on all other eligible purchases.

benefits.name: $10 Uber Cash
benefits.description: Up to $10 per month in Uber Cash for Uber rides or Uber Eats orders. Does not roll over.

benefits.name: $10 Dining Credit
benefits.description: Up to $10 per month at Grubhub, The Cheesecake Factory, Goldbelly, Wine.com, and Five Guys.

benefits.name: $7 Dunkin' Credit
benefits.description: Up to $7 per month in statement credits at U.S. Dunkin' locations.

benefits.name: $100 Resy Dining Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 per year in statement credits for dining at U.S. Resy restaurants.
